## Architecture
pack.py (stdlib only): reads orders.csv, includes status == "ready", plus status == "hold" only when approved == "yes" (exact); normalizes SKU (lowercase; '-' and ' ' -> '_'), sums units per SKU, cartons = ceil(units/6) (CARTON_SIZE = 6; 4-unit cartons obsolete), writes packing-report.csv (sku,units,cartons) sorted by sku.
## Path & Variable Directory
- pack.py — the tool; run: python pack.py orders.csv packing-report.csv
- orders.csv — input (order_id,sku,units,status,approved)
- packing-report.csv — generated output

## Hard Constraints
- Only status exactly "ready" is included. Held orders stay out (inventory not released) even when approved=yes; the approved column is ignored.
- Python standard library only.
